name: Cellvis P384-1.5H-N 384 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes:
Cellvis 384 well glass bottom plate, catalogue number P384-1.5H-N: black virgin-polystyrene frame, German #1.5H high-performance cover glass 0.170 +/- 0.005 mm thick bonded with a USP class VI adhesive, with a lid, individually packed, gamma sterilised, moulded in a class 100,000 clean room, 20 per case. Cellvis states the plate conforms to ANSI/SBS 1-2004. Publications cite the same plate as P384-1.5HN. Coated versions (poly-D-lysine, collagen and others) are sold under separate catalogue numbers on the same frame; Cellvis also sells this frame with other cover glass grades under other numbers, which are not this file. Units in meters; both Cellvis documents are in millimeters.

CONTROLLING DOCUMENT: Cellvis publishes NO engineering drawing for this plate - no title block, no revision, no PDF. The highest-authority document it offers is the DIMENSION DIAGRAM image on the 'Dimension diagram' tab of the product page, https://www.cellvis.com/images/glass_bottom_plate_384_well_size.png (drawing_reference): a plan view, a section through the edge and first well, and two views of the lid. It is undated and unrevisioned; retrieved 2026-10-30. SECOND DOCUMENT: the 'Technical specifications' table on the product page (web_reference): frame colour black; coverslip #1.5 high performance cover glass (0.170+/-0.005mm); Length 127.60 mm; Width 85.60 mm; Height 14.33 mm; Height with lid 16.80 mm; Bottom height 2.78 mm (bottom of coverslip to plate bottom), tolerance +/-50 um over the whole plate; Well to well center distance 4.50 mm; Well bottom area 10.89 mm2; Maximum volume 0.12 ml; temperature range -20 to 50 C. The two documents agree everywhere they overlap.

PRINTED, transcribed directly: footprint 127.6 x 85.6 mm and pitch 4.5 mm, from both documents; plate height 14.33 mm and height with lid 16.8 mm, from both; A1 centre 12.05 mm from the left edge, from the plan view; well depth 11.38 mm, well opening 3.7 mm and well bottom 3.3 mm, from the section; bottom_elevation 2.78 mm from the specification's 'Bottom height'. The square well bottom is confirmed independently by the specification's well bottom area: 3.3 x 3.3 = 10.89 mm2 exactly, so diameter (the side of the square bottom) is 3.3 mm and diameter_top (the side of the square opening) is 3.7 mm, the opening drawn at the top of the section and the bottom at the glass. bottom_thickness 0.00017 m is the published cover glass thickness. floor_height 2.95 mm is DERIVED as 2.78 + 0.17 and confirmed by the section: plate height less well depth, 14.33 - 11.38, is also 2.95 mm.

DERIVED: A1 offset from the top edge, 9.05 mm. The plan view prints 9.05 mm from the BOTTOM edge to the centre of the bottom-left well (P1), not to A1; with 16 rows at 4.5 mm, A1 is 85.6 - 9.05 - 15 x 4.5 = 9.05 mm from the top edge, so the grid is centred on the width. Along the length it is centred too: 12.05 + 23 x 4.5 = 115.55 mm, leaving 12.05 mm to the right edge. (The ANSI/SLAS 384 values, 12.13 and 8.99 mm, are NOT used.)

SCALED OFF THE PLAN VIEW, assumed to scale: the plan view calibrates to 3.264 px/mm on the footprint length and 3.266 px/mm on the A1-to-X1 well centres along it, and 3.265 px/mm on the footprint width and 3.259 px/mm on the A1-to-P1 well centres across it - all four within 0.2 %. The plate's BODY above the skirt (upper_outline) is inset from the footprint by 3.07, 2.92, 2.76 and 2.76 mm at the top, right, bottom and left edges, taken as a uniform 2.9 mm +/- 0.2 mm, and its two LEFT corners (at A1 and P1) are cut at about 45 degrees with legs of 5.7 mm +/- 0.3 mm, while its two right corners are plain: the plate's orientation feature, matched by one cut corner on the lid. Line centres were measured; the uncertainty is the drawn line width (about 1 px, 0.3 mm) and the spread between edges. The lid is drawn as 127.15 x 85.05 x 10 mm; those are not schema fields.

THE SECTION VIEW IS NOT TO SCALE and nothing was scaled off it: its 3.7 mm and 3.3 mm dimensions are drawn between extension lines the same 22 px apart. Consequently skirt_outline, skirt_height and skirt_thickness are NOT recorded and the standard footprint outline is assumed. The same frame and diagram style as Cellvis_P01-1.5H_1_well_plate.json.

NOT RECORDED: working_volume_min/max - Cellvis publishes only a 'Maximum volume' of 0.12 ml, which is a capacity, not a recommended working range (the brim-full frustum from the recorded numbers is about 0.14 ml); bottom_refractive_index - Cellvis does not publish one for its cover glass; wall_thickness; surface_treatments - P384-1.5H-N is plain uncoated glass; the corner radius of the square wells, which neither document gives.

THE REQUEST AGREED WITH THE VENDOR: the requester linked the P384-1.5H-N product page and named it by its title.
